Tourism · FOUNDING EDITION / 16 OCT 2026

Pedal Paradise shows how Nassau tours can become social experiences

A party bike blends local landmarks, music and group travel in one Nassau itinerary.

◍Tourism
BY CARIBBEAN BUSINESS ATLAS · COMMENTARY & COMPANY RESEARCH

Pedal Paradise Bahamas sells a distinctive way to experience Nassau: a group party-bike ride that brings together sightseeing and social activity rather than separating them.

The company's official site describes Sip & Spin, while the Bahamas tourism authority describes an electric-assisted pedal bike that travels through downtown and historic districts. Routes can include cultural landmarks, food stops and local businesses.

The model is relevant beyond this one operator. Packaging local experiences around a memorable format can make small tourism enterprises easier to explain and discover. Tour schedules, inclusions and stops should be confirmed at booking.
